route.title: Starting out
steps: Talk to Brundt in the longhall to start the quest. (Fairy ring and run south-west to Rellekka) Dialogue: "Do you have any quests?", "Yes, I am interested.", "I want to become a Fremennik!", or Dialogue: "Ask about anything else.", "Do you have any quests?", "Yes, I am interested.", "I want to become a Fremennik!" if started or finished Mountain Daughter
The trials may be done in any order, however this quick guide will show you the fastest order.

route.title: Manni the Reveller, Sigli the Huntsman, and Olaf the Bard
steps: Talk to Manni the Reveller while in the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Take the keg of beer and challenge Manni to a drinking contest. You will lose. Dialogue: "Yes"
If you did not bring a beer, grab the beer tankard now.
Talk to Sigli the Huntsman outside, near the entrance of the longhall, to obtain the Hunters' Talisman. Dialogue: "What's a Draugen?", "Yes"
Talk to Olaf the Bard just east of the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Talk to Olaf again. Dialogue: "I don't need a reminder"
To get a lyre, either make it yourself (Requires and 6 free inventory spaces) or kill Lanzig (1/17 drop rate). Killing lanzig takes longer on average. You must enchant it either way.

route.title: Seers' Village
steps: Teleport to Camelot or walk to Seers' Village.
If you are making the lyre yourself:
Go to the Seers' Village pub and talk to the Poison Salesman to buy a low alcohol keg for 250 coins. Dialogue: "Talk about the Fremennik Trials", "Yes"
Buy a regular beer if you forgot to take a beer tankard. Dialogue: "Beer please."

route.title: Back to Rellekka
steps: Use a Rellekka house teleport to return, or simply walk back. If walking, left-click on your talisman to check if The Draugen is nearby on your way. If so, kill him.
Use the beer, or beer tankard, on the council workman by the bridge south of Rellekka to obtain strange object.
Go north across the bridge, then walk a bit west until you see a small narrow path heading south into the water. (The large rib cage sticking out of the water on the left side of the bridge)
Use your raw shark/manta ray/sea turtle on the strange altar to enchant your lyre.
Follow your talisman by left-clicking on it and kill The Draugen now if you haven't already. Appears as a grey butterfly before locating the correct tile.
Once done, head back into Rellekka and talk to Sigli at the entrance.
Head to the outside of the longhall to the pipe on the eastern wall. Use a tinderbox on your strange object and use the lit strange object on the pipe.
Enter the north-eastern back door of the longhall, walk onto the stage, and play your enchanted lyre.
Exit the back door, enter the main long hall, and take a keg of beer off the table.
Use your low alcohol keg on the keg of beer.
Challenge Manni to a drinking contest again. Dialogue: "Yes"

route.title: Sigmund the Merchant and Swensen the Navigator
steps: Talk to Sigmund The Merchant in the market west of the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Talk to the Sailor on the docks to the north-west. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Olaf the Bard just east of the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Yrsa at the clothing store west of the market. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"

Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial" or Dialogue: "Ask about anything else", "Ask about the Merchant's trial" if you are doing or have finished Mountain Daughter
Talk to Sigli the Huntsman just south of the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Skulgrimen in the hut just north of the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to the Fisherman north of the market. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Swensen the Navigator in the building south of the market. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Swensen again. Dialogue: "Ask about becoming a Fremennik", "Yes"
Climb down the ladder and take the South, West, East, North, South, East, then North portals. Climb up the ladder.
Talk to Peer the Seer just north-west of Swensen. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Thorvald the Warrior in the hut just north of the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Askeladden in front of the longhall, pay him 5,000 coins. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial", "Yes"
Head back and talk to (in order):

route.title: Thorvald the Warrior
steps: Go to a bank (The Seers' Village bank is close) and deposit all of your items (you cannot have any weapons, armour, or runes).
Bring equipment for the fight:
Talk to Thorvald just north of the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Climb down the ladder. If you have a knife and dramen branch, cut it into a staff and equip it. You can also use celastrus bark to fletch a battlestaff.

Fight the first 3 forms of Koschei the Deathless without weapons, armour, or runes. (You can pray flick him for the first 3 forms. Dying in the room is safe, even for regular Hardcore Ironmen). Do not go up the ladder after completing the 3rd form - it is safe to die from the 4th form.

You can choose to let the 4th form kill you (this is safe for Group Hardcore Ironmen as Koschei will not actually finish you in this form; the player will faint and wake up upstairs rather than being killed), or you can kill it (slower and is not necessary).
Talk to Thorvald again.

route.title: Peer the Seer
steps: Talk to Peer the Seer south-west of the market. Dialogue: "Yes", "Yes"
Open the door to his house, south-west of the market (with a green bed), and read the riddle.
Each line of the riddle gives you one letter of a four-letter word. See the table below for the first riddle line and the related answer.
Open the door again and climb-up the ladder.
Search/study these objects to get a bucket, red disk, wooden disk, jug, and red herring:
Use the red herring on the cooking range.
Use the sticky red goop on the wooden disk.
Open the trapdoor on the east side, climb-down the trapdoor, and use the two red disks on the abstract mural.
Return upstairs and use the bucket on the tap by the cooking range.
Use the full bucket on the jug.
Use the jug on the drain.
Use the 2/5ths bucket on the empty jug.
Refill the bucket.
Use the full bucket on the 2/3rds jug.
Use the 4/5ths bucket on the northern chest with the scale.
Fill the vase with water and add the lid.
Use the sealed vase on the frozen table.
Use the frozen key on the cooking range.
Climb-down the eastern trapdoor, and you can now open the door to leave.

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain.
Congratulations, quest complete!
